name: 思维导图
description: 在 IDE 里画思维导图：键盘快速建节点、拖拽调整结构、折叠分支，可导出 PNG / SVG / Markdown。文件保存为 .mind（JSON），方便用 Git 管理。IDE 里的 AI 助手可以读取和编辑导图。

agentTools.name: getMap
agentTools.description: Read the whole mind map as a JSON tree: every node has an `id` (needed by the other tools), `text`, and `children`. Pass format "markdown" to get a Markdown outline instead.

agentTools.name: addNodes
agentTools.description: Add one or more nodes (with sub-branches) under a parent node. Give either `outline` — an indented Markdown list such as "- A\n  - A1\n- B" — or `nodes`. Returns the new nodes' ids.

parent.description: Id of the parent node. Default: the root.

outline.description: Indented list ("- " items, 2 spaces per level) or Markdown headings.

nodes.description: Alternative to outline: strings, or objects { text, children: [...] }.

index.description: Position among the parent's children (0 = first). Default: at the end.

agentTools.name: updateNodes
agentTools.description: Change nodes: rename them, collapse / expand branches, or put a top-level branch on the left or right of the root. Pass one change directly (id, text, ...) or several in `updates`.

side.description: Only for children of the root.

agentTools.name: moveNode
agentTools.description: Move a node (with its whole branch) under another parent, or to another position among its siblings.

parent.description: Id of the new parent. Default: the root.

index.description: Position among the new parent's children. Default: at the end.

agentTools.name: deleteNodes
agentTools.description: Delete nodes together with their branches.

agentTools.name: setMap
agentTools.description: Replace the whole mind map with a new one. With a single top-level item in `outline`, that item becomes the central topic; otherwise pass `title` for the central topic and the top-level items become its branches. Use this to create a map from scratch.

nodes.description: Alternative to outline: strings or { text, children } objects.

agentTools.name: screenshot
agentTools.description: By default the whole map is fitted into view; pass `id` to center a node instead.
